understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each KA59 level by moving the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked '+' in the semantic grid is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time; once all goals are covered the level reports WIN, and finishing all levels wins the run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions (MOVE_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT) attempt to shift the currently selected piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) in that direction, but movement can fail if blocked by walls/boundaries or other blocking objects; some adjacent objects may be pushable and get moved along when you move into them. Levels can include multiple selectable pieces, and you change which one you control by using CLICK with the exact pixel/grid coordinate of the target selectable (matching the positions listed in state/objects), after which movement commands apply to the newly selected piece. The movement_blocked flags serve only as hints about adjacency and do not guarantee whether a move will succeed.
